_note: Edition selector. 'default' loads config/prompts.json + config/agent_persona.txt (the standard ErnosDecent node). 'business' loads config/business/prompts.json + config/business/agent_persona.txt when present (the Business edition overlay). The edition is COSMETIC ONLY — it changes prompts/persona/branding, never the P2P/DHT/relay mesh services. A business node is a full mesh node; that coupling is what makes the cost savings (and the passive mesh benefit) possible.
